bulk95_definition: bulk95 = percentile(|lambda|, 95) / |lambda_1|, over the FULL spectrum of the un-rescaled recurrent matrix W (the Perron outlier is included in the percentile population). Computed by src.analysis.spectral.recurrent_spectrum as `bulk95_radius` on the normalised base W / |lambda_1|; identical formula to spectral_metrics' `bulk95_ratio`.
